text: Landed; ticket was never closed, though its sibling 're-point the NFRD court at the extracted primitives' was. All four primitives are in their new home and nothing was generalized out of NfrdBaseballVerifier, which stays where it is and specialized: RelativeArtifactPath (corpus/artifact.scala:17, path safety, with disclose added for NFRD reuse), the Reader shape as trait ArtifactStore with the NEW list method (manifest.scala:183-184, enumerable so completeness is checkable both directions), ArtifactReceipt (artifact.scala:93, label+bytes+checksum with the path hidden from toString), and the RootIssue / ReadOperation refusal taxonomy (artifact.scala:64,75). Shared artifact verification and retained-byte snapshots remain DISTINCT contracts, as the bead required.
